correctness.rationale: Taking leaf coordinate differences yields exactly −(1+λh)(u_j−v_j), so all active pairs are equal and either zero or y=1−1/(λh). The scalar cubic is strictly single-peaked on 0<y<1−1/λ, with maximum 4k(λ−1)^3/(27λ); hence precisely 0/1/2 branches and exact binomial subset count. Every inactive petal has Jacobian eigenvalue −1+λh>0. For full support, the two-dimensional hub-symmetric block has negative trace, determinant (3λy−2(λ−1))/(λ(1−y)−1), positive only on upper branch, and all transverse leaf modes have negative real parts. Independently checked the exact Jacobian determinant reduction, fold maximum, and rational m=2,λ=4,y=1/4 equilibrium using symbolic arithmetic, corroborating the inspected verify.py. Boundary λ=λ_m is nonhyperbolic, not claimed exponentially stable.

value.rationale: The friendship graph is the canonical overlapping-triangle sparse family. Unlike the usual two-branch mean-field picture, it yields an explicit exponentially large set of physical but unstable partial-support equilibria, ordered sharp fold thresholds and a complete local stability classification. These structural facts reveal how localized higher-order contagion affects equilibrium multiplicity; no claims are made about global basins.
